form.label: Linux
form.description: Logins, admin changes and persistence on Rocky, Ubuntu and Debian.

html.p: Learn which account and IP the scored SSH check uses.

search.query: `linux_auth` "Accepted" | rex "Accepted (?<method>\S+) for (?<user>\S+) from (?<src>\S+)" | stats count latest(_time) as last by host user src method | sort - last | convert ctime(last)

panel.title: Alert: Root logged in over SSH

html.p: Severity 5. Someone logged in as root over SSH. Playbook steps (page 14)

search.query: `linux_auth` "Accepted" "for root" | rex "Accepted (?<method>\S+) for (?<user>\S+) from (?<src>\S+)" | table _time host user src method

panel.title: Alert: Linux user or group changed

html.p: Severity 5. A Linux account or group was created, deleted or given new members. Playbook steps (page 14)

search.query: `linux_auth` ("new user" OR "new group" OR "delete user" OR "to group" OR "added by") | rex "(?<program>useradd|groupadd|usermod|userdel|gpasswd|groupmod|adduser)" | table _time host program _raw

html.p: Severity 4. One IP failed 10+ SSH logins in 5 minutes. Playbook steps (page 15)

search.query: `linux_auth` "Failed password" | rex "Failed password for (invalid user )?(?<user>\S+) from (?<src>\S+)" | stats count dc(user) as users values(user) as tried by host src | where count>=10 | sort - count

html.p: Severity 4. Someone edited a user's crontab. Playbook steps (page 15)

search.query: `linux_auth` "Failed password" | rex "Failed password for (invalid user )?(?<user>\S+) from (?<src>\S+)" | stats count values(user) as tried by host src | sort - count

`linux_syslog` ("Stopped" OR "Failed with result" OR "Main process exited") (httpd OR nginx OR apache2 OR postfix OR dovecot OR vsftpd OR sshd OR ssh OR mariadb OR mysqld OR mysql OR php-fpm OR Splunkd OR SplunkForwarder) | table _time host _raw
